# Default Account Hub branding assertions describe the opposite attribute state

The default-header and post-account checks negate hasAttribute("aria-hidden") but say the name/title should not be exposed. Those messages describe the opposite tested state. The original also says to show welcome text while asserting it is hidden. Accepted component source repairs that hidden-text message, while the integration message and opposite attribute messages remain. Use messages that name the actual expected predicate; presence alone does not establish accessible-tree behavior.

Scope: account-hub-tests.
